book: Please quote CFR Alexandria and confirm the lead time, warranty period, MOQ and payment terms.

family.ex: Please quote your best price for 40 x 12V 100Ah batteries.
family.ar: من فضلك ادّينا أحسن سعر لـ40 بطارية ‎12V 100Ah‎.
family.ex2: Quote CFR Alexandria, not FOB, so we can compare offers.
family.ar2: سعّر ‎CFR‎ إسكندرية مش ‎FOB‎، عشان نقدر نقارن العروض.

family.ex: Can you send me a quick quote for two VFDs?
family.ex2: The customer wants the quote before Sunday's meeting.
family.ar2: العميل عايز السعر قبل اجتماع الحد.

family.ex: Our quotation for the 60 kVA UPS is valid for 30 days.
family.ar: عرض السعر بتاعنا للـ‎UPS‎ الـ‎60 kVA‎ صالح 30 يوم.
family.ex2: After that, the quotation may change with the dollar rate.
family.ar2: بعد كده عرض السعر ممكن يتغير مع سعر الدولار.

family.ex: The quoted price does not include installation.
family.ar: السعر اللي اتقال مش شامل التركيب.
family.ex2: Installation is quoted separately at EGP 15,000.

meanings.ex: Can you quote us for 20 UPS batteries by Thursday?
meanings.ar: ممكن تسعّر لنا 20 بطارية ‎UPS‎ قبل الخميس؟
meanings.ex2: We need to quote the hospital next week.
meanings.ar2: محتاجين نقدّم سعر للمستشفى الأسبوع الجاي.

meanings.ex: Please quote PO-2025-164 on your invoice.
meanings.ex2: Our accounts team cannot match invoices without the PO number.
meanings.ar2: الحسابات مش بتقدر تطابق الفواتير من غير رقم الـ‎PO‎.

syn.note: full proposal with price, terms and conditions
syn.ex: Shenzhen VoltTech sent their offer with a 3-year warranty.
syn.ex2: Their offer is cheap, but the lead time is long.
syn.ar2: عرضهم رخيص، بس مدة التوريد طويلة.

syn.note: rough cost that may change later
syn.ex: This is only an estimate; the final price depends on the site survey.
syn.ar: ده تقدير مبدئي بس؛ السعر النهائي حسب معاينة الموقع.
syn.ex2: We will send a firm quotation after the visit.
syn.ar2: هنبعت عرض سعر نهائي بعد الزيارة.

syn.ex: We need to price the solar project before Thursday.
syn.ar: لازم نحط سعر لمشروع الطاقة الشمسية قبل الخميس.
syn.ex2: Ahmed will price the inverters and cables first.

steps.ex: Our estimate for the server room upgrade is about EGP 2 million.
steps.ar: تقديرنا لتطوير غرفة السيرفرات حوالي 2 مليون جنيه.
steps.ex2: It may change after we see the site.
steps.ar2: ممكن يتغير بعد ما نشوف الموقع.

steps.ex: Here is a quick quote for the battery replacement.
steps.ex2: A formal quotation will follow tomorrow.

steps.ex: Please find attached our signed quotation QT-25-311.
steps.ex2: The quotation is valid until 31 October.

steps.ex: The supplier sent a proforma invoice for the deposit.
steps.ar: المورد بعت فاتورة مبدئية عشان العربون.
steps.ex2: Our bank needs the proforma invoice signed and stamped.
steps.ar2: البنك محتاج الفاتورة المبدئية متمضية ومختومة.

ctx: Please quote CFR Alexandria, not FOB Shenzhen. We need the freight included to compare the three offers.
ctx_ar: من فضلك سعّر ‎CFR‎ إسكندرية مش ‎FOB Shenzhen‎. محتاجين الشحن يبقى داخل عشان نقارن التلات عروض.

quiz.s: The ___ price does not include VAT.
Could you ___ us CFR Alexandria for 120 modules?
quiz.ar: ممكن تسعّر لنا ‎CFR‎ إسكندرية لـ120 موديول؟

quiz.s: This is just a rough ___; the final price comes after the site visit.
quiz.ar: ده تقدير تقريبي بس؛ السعر النهائي بعد زيارة الموقع.

book: Finally, could you confirm the MOQ and whether a 5-year warranty is possible?

family.ex: Please confirm the lead time for the 51.2V modules.
family.ar: من فضلك أكّد مدة التوريد للموديولات الـ‎51.2V‎.
family.ex2: Please confirm it in writing so we can plan the project.
family.ar2: ياريت تأكّدها كتابةً عشان نخطط المشروع.

family.ex: We are still waiting for the order confirmation from VoltTech.
family.ex2: Without the confirmation, Finance won't pay the deposit.
family.ar2: من غير التأكيد، الحسابات مش هتدفع العربون.

family.ex: The booking is confirmed on a vessel leaving Shekou on 22 October.
family.ar: الحجز متأكد على مركب طالعة من ‎Shekou‎ يوم 22 أكتوبر.
family.ex2: The confirmed booking means we can tell the hospital.
family.ar2: الحجز المتأكد معناه إننا نقدر نبلّغ المستشفى.

family.ex: The delivery date is still unconfirmed, so don't promise the client.
family.ar: ميعاد التسليم لسه مش متأكد، فمتوعدش العميل.
family.ex2: Wait for the unconfirmed date to be fixed.

syn.ex: Please verify the HS code before you upload the invoice.
syn.ar: من فضلك اتأكد من الـ‎HS code‎ قبل ما ترفع الفاتورة.
syn.ex2: Please verify it now; a wrong code can mean fines.
syn.ar2: اتأكد منه دلوقتي؛ كود غلط ممكن يجيب غرامات.

syn.ex: Please acknowledge receipt of our PO-2025-164.
syn.ex2: A short reply is enough to acknowledge it.
syn.ar2: رد قصير كفاية إنك تأكّد الاستلام.

syn.ex: The Finance Director must approve the PO before we send it.
syn.ar: المدير المالي لازم يوافق على الـ‎PO‎ قبل ما نبعته.
syn.ex2: He usually approves orders on the same day.
syn.ar2: هو عادةً بيوافق على الأوردرات في نفس اليوم.

ant.ex: The customer cancelled the order for two UPS units.
ant.ex2: He cancelled it because the budget was cut.

steps.ex: Let's pencil in the site visit for Monday.
steps.ar: خلّينا نحط زيارة الموقع مبدئيًا يوم الاتنين.
steps.ex2: I will pencil it in until the client replies.
steps.ar2: هحطها مبدئيًا لحد ما العميل يرد.

steps.ex: The supplier agreed in principle to a 5-year warranty.
steps.ar: المورد وافق مبدئيًا على ضمان 5 سنين.
steps.ex2: Details will come after they agree in principle on price.
steps.ar2: التفاصيل هتيجي بعد ما يوافقوا مبدئيًا على السعر.

steps.ex: VoltTech confirmed the price of USD 1,040 per unit.
steps.ex2: Now we can confirm the order internally.

steps.ex: Please confirm in writing that the goods ship on 22 October.
steps.ar: من فضلك أكّد كتابةً إن البضاعة هتتشحن يوم 22 أكتوبر.
steps.ex2: Our bank asks us to confirm in writing.

ctx: Could you confirm the MOQ for this model? If it is 200 units, we need to change our plan.
ctx_ar: ممكن تأكّد الحد الأدنى للطلب للموديل ده؟ لو 200 وحدة، هنحتاج نغيّر خطتنا.

quiz.s: Please send written ___ of the delivery date.
quiz.ar: من فضلك ابعت تأكيد مكتوب لميعاد التسليم.

quiz.s: The booking is still ___, so don't tell the customer yet.
quiz.ar: الحجز لسه مش متأكد، فمتقولش للعميل لسه.

quiz.s: Please ___ receipt of our purchase order.
quiz.ar: من فضلك أكّد استلام أمر الشراء بتاعنا.

book: Could you please revise your offer to include sea freight to Alexandria port?

family.ex: Please revise the quotation to show CFR prices.
family.ar: من فضلك عدّل عرض السعر يبيّن أسعار ‎CFR‎.
family.ex2: Please revise it before Thursday's comparison meeting.
family.ar2: ياريت تعدّله قبل اجتماع المقارنة يوم الخميس.

family.ex: Thank you for your revised offer VT-2025-0912.
family.ex2: The revised offer now includes freight to Alexandria.
family.ar2: العرض المعدّل دلوقتي شامل الشحن لإسكندرية.

family.ex: This is the third revision of the maintenance contract.
family.ex2: Each revision adds a new site to the contract.
family.ar2: كل مراجعة بتزوّد موقع جديد للعقد.

syn.note: formal: change a contract or official document
syn.ex: We need to amend clause 4 of the service contract.
syn.ar: محتاجين نعدّل البند 4 في عقد الخدمة.
syn.ex2: Both parties must sign the amended contract.

syn.ex: Please update the price list with the new dollar rate.
syn.ar: من فضلك حدّث قايمة الأسعار بسعر الدولار الجديد.
syn.ex2: Send the update to all sales engineers.

syn.note: small change to a number or setting
syn.ex: We can adjust the price by 2% for a bigger quantity.
syn.ar: نقدر نظبط السعر 2% لو الكمية أكبر.
syn.ex2: The technician also adjusted the VFD settings on site.
syn.ar2: والفني كمان ظبط إعدادات الـ‎VFD‎ في الموقع.

steps.ex: Can you adjust the delivery date by two days?
steps.ex2: A small change like that is fine.
steps.ar2: تغيير صغير زي ده مفيهوش مشكلة.

steps.ex: Please revise the offer to include the 5-year warranty.
steps.ar: من فضلك عدّل العرض يشمل ضمان 5 سنين.
steps.ex2: The price may change in the revised offer.
steps.ar2: السعر ممكن يتغير في العرض المعدّل.

steps.ex: We had to redo the whole quotation for the new site.
steps.ar: اضطرينا نعمل عرض السعر كله من الأول للموقع الجديد.
steps.ex2: The client changed the UPS size, so we redo everything.
steps.ar2: العميل غيّر مقاس الـ‎UPS‎، فبنعمل كل حاجة من الأول.

ctx: VoltTech quoted FOB Shenzhen by mistake. We asked them to revise the offer to CFR Alexandria.
ctx_ar: ‎VoltTech‎ سعّروا ‎FOB Shenzhen‎ بالغلط. طلبنا منهم يعدّلوا العرض لـ‎CFR‎ إسكندرية.

quiz.s: Please send the ___ offer by tomorrow.
quiz.ar: من فضلك ابعت العرض المعدّل بكرة.

quiz.s: This is the third ___ of the quotation.
We must ___ clause 4 of the contract and sign it again.
quiz.ar: لازم نعدّل البند 4 في العقد ونمضيه تاني.

book: We would appreciate your offer by Thursday, 11 September.

family.ex: We would appreciate your reply by Sunday.
family.ar: هنكون ممنونين لو رديت قبل الحد.
family.ex2: We appreciate your help with the urgent shipment.

family.ex: As a sign of our appreciation, we added a free battery test.
family.ar: كتقدير مننا، زوّدنا اختبار بطاريات ببلاش.
family.ex2: The customer sent a letter of appreciation to our service team.
family.ar2: العميل بعت جواب شكر لفريق الخدمة بتاعنا.

family.ex: Your quick reply is much appreciated.
family.ex2: Any discount on freight would be appreciated.
family.ar2: أي خصم على الشحن هيبقى متقدّر.

family.ex: The hospital was very appreciative of our fast UPS repair.
family.ar: المستشفى كانت ممنونة جدًا من تصليح الـ‎UPS‎ السريع.
family.ex2: They were appreciative and renewed the maintenance contract.

syn.note: more formal and warm than appreciate
syn.ex: We would be grateful if you could send the MSDS today.
syn.ar: هنكون ممنونين لو تقدر تبعت الـ‎MSDS‎ النهارده.
syn.ex2: We would be grateful for a quick reply, as customs needs it.
syn.ar2: هنكون ممنونين لو رديت بسرعة، لأن الجمارك محتاجاه.

syn.note: shows something is important to you long-term
syn.ex: We value our partnership with Shenzhen VoltTech.
syn.ex2: We value their quality more than a low price.
syn.ar2: بنقدّر جودتهم أكتر من السعر الرخيص.

syn.note: say you are happy to receive something
syn.ex: We would welcome your feedback on the new service report.
syn.ar: يسعدنا نسمع رأيك في تقرير الخدمة الجديد.
syn.ex2: Your feedback is welcome before we print it.
syn.ar2: رأيك مرحّب بيه قبل ما نطبعه.

steps.ex2: Send it to the store, please; they are waiting.
Please send it to Hany as well.

steps.ex: We would appreciate the datasheet today.
steps.ar: هنكون ممنونين لو الداتاشيت وصل النهارده.
steps.ex2: We would appreciate the MSDS as well.
steps.ar2: وهنكون ممنونين لو الـ‎MSDS‎ وصل كمان.

steps.ex: We would be grateful if you could send the datasheet today.
steps.ar: هنكون شاكرين جدًا لو تقدر تبعت الداتاشيت النهارده.
steps.ex2: We would be grateful if you could include the UN38.3 report too.
steps.ar2: وهنكون شاكرين لو تقدر تضيف تقرير ‎UN38.3‎ كمان.

ctx: We would appreciate your best offer by Thursday. Please include the datasheet and the UN38.3 test report.
ctx_ar: هنكون ممنونين لو أحسن عرض عندك وصل قبل الخميس. ياريت تضيف الداتاشيت وتقرير اختبار ‎UN38.3‎.

quiz.s: As a sign of our ___, we added free delivery.
We would be ___ if you could send the MSDS today.
quiz.ar: هنكون ممنونين لو تقدر تبعت الـ‎MSDS‎ النهارده.

book: I want a comparison sheet on my desk by Thursday, 18 September.

family.ex: Please compare the three battery offers before Thursday.
family.ar: من فضلك قارن عروض البطاريات التلاتة قبل الخميس.
family.ex2: Compare price, warranty and lead time, not price only.
family.ar2: قارن السعر والضمان ومدة التوريد، مش السعر بس.

family.ex: The comparison sheet shows VoltTech is 6% more expensive.
family.ar: شيت المقارنة بيوضح إن ‎VoltTech‎ أغلى بـ6%.
family.ex2: But the comparison also shows a longer warranty.
family.ar2: بس المقارنة كمان بتوضح ضمان أطول.

family.ex: HexaCell's modules are comparable in quality to VoltTech's.
family.ar: موديولات ‎HexaCell‎ قريبة في الجودة من بتوع ‎VoltTech‎.
family.ex2: Their prices, however, are not comparable because of the MOQ.
family.ar2: بس أسعارهم مش قابلة للمقارنة بسبب الحد الأدنى للطلب.

syn.note: judging offers against set criteria and scores
syn.ex: The technical evaluation of the UPS offers is finished.
syn.ex2: Two offers failed the evaluation because of efficiency.
syn.ar2: عرضين وقعوا في التقييم بسبب الكفاءة.

syn.note: compare with a standard or market price
syn.ex: We benchmark our service prices against two competitors.
syn.ar: بنقيس أسعار الخدمة بتاعتنا على اتنين منافسين.
syn.ex2: The benchmark shows our prices are fair.

syn.note: detailed study of numbers or facts
syn.ex: Please send a cost analysis for local and imported batteries.
syn.ar: من فضلك ابعت تحليل تكلفة للبطاريات المحلية والمستوردة.
syn.ex2: The analysis must include duties and freight.

ctx: Hany wants a comparison of the three supplier offers. Please show price, lead time, warranty and payment terms side by side.
ctx_ar: هاني عايز مقارنة بين عروض الموردين التلاتة. من فضلك اعرض السعر ومدة التوريد والضمان وشروط الدفع جنب بعض.

quiz.s: Please ___ the three offers before Thursday.
quiz.ar: من فضلك قارن التلات عروض قبل الخميس.

quiz.s: VoltTech's warranty is not ___ with the cheaper supplier's.
quiz.ar: ضمان ‎VoltTech‎ مش ممكن يتقارن بضمان المورد الأرخص.

quiz.s: Put all prices in one ___ sheet.
quiz.ar: حط كل الأسعار في شيت مقارنة واحد.
